text:
alex_sales: Quick heads-up — Acme legal and infra want a 2-week POC to validate streaming + function-calls + structured JSON outputs. They also flagged a security questionnaire due Fri. Can we scope a minimal runbook?

maya_se: Yep. We should confirm a few constraints: will they need Dedicated capacity for guaranteed latency, or Hosted with regional routing?

emma_acme: Hi all — we prefer hosted to start, but we need <100ms tail latency on short chats and ability to call external tools (function calls) to fetch user records. Security questionnaire is attached (link: https://acme.example/qna).

alex_sales: Thanks @emma_acme. @maya_se, rough estimate on cost for hosted streaming + function invocation at 50 RPS sustained? They asked about monthly run costs.

maya_se: Rough ballpark: hosted token pricing + small per-request function-call overhead. For 50 RPS (3.6M requests/day) — if avg response ~150 tokens, monthly token spend ~16B tokens. That pushes them toward a Dedicated eval for unit economics. I can draft an estimator.

maya_se: For the POC scope I suggest: 1) Streaming SSE to web clients, 2) Tool/Function call demo (user lookup), 3) Structured JSON outputs (strict schema) + regression tests. Keep dataset small.

tomas_engineer: On the runtime side, we can enable continuous batching + KV cache to keep cost down. For function calls we recommend using the small sync worker pattern: LM returns a tool-call with args, we call their service, then send the result back in a follow-up message.

emma_acme: Can you share a quick SDK example for streaming + function call? Need to show to infra folks.

maya_se: Sure — minimal JS example:```js
// client: open SSE socket
const s = new EventSource('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-small');
s.onmessage = (e) => console.log('chunk', e.data);
// server: starting a function call flow
const resp = await client.chat.create({
  messages: [{role:'user', content:'Get user 12345'}],
  functions: [{name:'get_user', schema:{id:'string'}}],
  stream:true
});
// on tool-call from stream, call customer's API then send followup
```

maya_se: For strict structured output use our `output_schema` param so the model returns valid JSON objects you can parse and assert against in tests.

olivia_security: Security notes: we need IP allowlist + short-lived API keys for the POC, plus KMS for any customer secrets. We can provide an on-prem connector if they need air-gapped. Also check SSO/SAML requirement in their questionnaire (Q12).

emma_acme: We do require SAML SSO for team access. For the POC, can we do scoped developer accounts and rotate creds weekly?

olivia_security: Scoped dev accounts + ephemeral keys are fine for POC. We'll need PRD to confirm retention and export controls. Send the questionnaire answers by EOD Thurs and we can sign off before Fri.

alex_sales: Action items: @maya_se — produce cost estimator + minimal repo with the JS example and a small runbook; @tomas_engineer — prepare a dedicated config option in case they flip to Dedicated; @olivia_security — I'll send the questionnaire answers and ask Emma for their SSO metadata.

maya_se: I'll scaffold a repo with README and two demo flows: (A) streaming chat -> function call -> structured JSON (B) structured-only responses validated by schema. ETA: tomorrow noon.

emma_acme: Great. For pricing can you include a 2-week Dedicated trial price and hosted estimate? Also need details on SLAs for Dedicated.

alex_sales: Will include both. @deploy-bot — can you provision a temporary eval key with IP allowlist for acme.example (CIDR 198.51.100.0/24)?

deploy-bot: Created ephemeral key: redwood-test-ACME-172h — expires in 7 days. IP allowlist set to 198.51.100.0/24. Audit log created.

tomas_engineer: Note: to keep latency under 100ms you'll want to pin model to a small, low-latency variant and set batching max latency to 20ms. Documenting in runbook.

maya_se: Also adding a small eval test harness (pytest) that asserts structured output schema and function-call correctness. Will push to the repo and share link.

olivia_security: I'll review the draft answers after you push. If SAML metadata is provided I can do a quick IdP test in the staging console.

emma_acme: Uploading SAML metadata to the shared folder now. Thanks everyone — please add any blockers.

alex_sales: Only blocker I see: final legal on the DPA. I'll loop in legal if we need changes. Otherwise looks good. :thumbsup:

maya_se: Pushing initial PR in ~2 hours. I'll @mention this thread when it's ready.

emma_acme: Thanks — excited to get started.

alex_sales: Closing plan for now. We'll reconvene after maya's PR and the security review.
